articles.title: State hackers drive 420% surge in onchain malware, Chainalysis finds
articles.description: North Korea-linked hackers used Tron, Aptos and BNB Chain to maintain malware infrastructure, while suspected Iran-linked actors embedded directions in Bitcoin transactions.

articles.title: Zcash gains 20% as Paradigm founder reveals firm made ZEC investment
articles.description: Zcash rose about 20% in 24 hours as Paradigm co-founder Matt Huang disclosed that the firm invested in ZEC amid a broader crypto market rally.

articles.title: Revolut says no direct contact after $3 million public ransom demand
articles.description: Revolut says it received no direct contact despite separate ransom demands for $3 million in Monero and 10,000 Bitcoin from competing breach claimants.

articles.title: Polymarket users referred to prosecutors in South Korea: Report
articles.description: South Korean police reportedly referred 18 Polymarket users to prosecutors in a gambling probe involving 26 people and $12.7 million in bets.

articles.title: Bitcoin treasuries buy just 5.9K BTC in three months as paper losses linger
articles.description: Bitcoin corporate treasuries remained at an unrealized loss on their holdings as the price fell below $80,000 and fresh capital inflows dwindled.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: BitMEX faces Celsius lawsuit ahead of exchange closure
articles.description: The Celsius estate alleges BitMEX wrongfully liquidated and seized 6,360 BTC, worth nearly $490 million, during the March 2020 market crash.

articles.title: OpenAI discloses 6 new cases of ‘misaligned’ AI behavior
articles.description: The six cases are separate from July’s incident, when OpenAI models escaped containment and hacked Hugging Face during a security evaluation.

articles.title: Bitcoin absorbs Fed rate hike as officials see more tightening
articles.description: Bitcoin showed little immediate reaction to the Fed’s first rate increase since 2023, but 16 of 18 officials expect at least one more hike before the end of the year.

articles.title: US lawmakers advance bill to lock Trump’s Bitcoin reserve into law
articles.description: The legislation seeks to codify Trump’s Bitcoin reserve policy, locking up Bitcoin acquired through civil and criminal forfeiture for 20 years.

articles.title: CLARITY Act could get another shot during lame-duck session, policy advocate says
articles.description: Digital Sovereignty Alliance managing director Adrian Wall said senators from both parties are considering another attempt to advance the crypto market structure bill before the current Congress ends.

articles.title: UK FCA sets crypto authorization guidance ahead of September application window
articles.description: The FCA’s new guidance outlines which crypto activities may require authorization as firms prepare for the UK’s incoming digital asset regulatory regime.

articles.title: US House tax committee advances crypto tax overhaul in 38–5 vote
articles.description: A bipartisan House committee vote advanced legislation that would reshape federal tax rules for stablecoins, staking, crypto lending and digital asset transactions.

articles.title: Anchorage expands institutional custody to Etherlink, tokenized uranium
articles.description: Anchorage Digital Bank added custody support for Etherlink and several Etherlink-based assets, including xU3O8, a token representing physical uranium.

articles.title: Coinbase faces greater fallout from CLARITY Act setback: Saxo
articles.description: A strategist at the Danish bank said Coinbase has more at stake in the CLARITY setback because its trading business is directly exposed to US market-structure rules.

articles.title: Bitcoin awaits Fed rate decision below $76K as analysis discounts ‘dovish surprise’ odds
articles.description: Bitcoin price support materialized around $68,000 as markets saw a 93% chance of the Fed hiking rates by 0.25% on Wednesday.

articles.title: Revolut ID thefts highlight KYC’s dangers: Here’s how to fix it
articles.description: Zero-knowledge technology could let companies verify who you are without storing your identity documents. So why isn’t it already standard practice?

articles.title: Bernstein expects ‘aggressive’ rulemaking from SEC, CFTC, following CLARITY Act failure
articles.description: Bernstein said the federal agencies will publish new regulations to compensate for the time lost negotiating the CLARITY Act, after its cloture vote failed on Tuesday.

articles.title: Zcash holders back 25-second blocks, vote to keep ZEC halving schedule
articles.description: Nearly 99% of ZEC holders voted to reduce block times to 25 seconds, while keeping ZEC issuance and halving schedules unchanged.

articles.title: Circle launches Arc mainnet with USDC as native gas token
articles.description: Circle’s Arc mainnet is live with USDC for transaction fees, support for more than 20 fiat stablecoins and links to over 20 blockchains.

articles.title: Deutsche Bank awaits regulatory nod to launch institutional crypto custody solutions
articles.description: Germany’s largest bank is awaiting regulatory approval to launch institutional custody solutions for Bitcoin, Ether and select stablecoins before expanding into tokenized assets.

articles.title: Ethiopia cuts Bitcoin miners’ power by 77% amid hydropower shortage: Report
articles.description: Bitcoin miners generated 35% of the state-owned power producer’s revenue last year, but declining reservoir inflows led the utility to prioritize households and manufacturers.

articles.title: Italy investigates government email breach linked to Revolut data leak
articles.description: Italy is probing the Revolut-linked breach after its cyber agency reported more than 650 cases involving abused or illicit certified email accounts.

articles.title: Bitcoin Coinbase Premium hits monthly low as CLARITY Act vote squeezes US demand
articles.description: Bitcoin exchange demand on Coinbase declined after the US Senate voted against the CLARITY Act, while traders sent BTC to exchanges at an unrealized loss.

articles.title: ECB seeks online merchants for 2027 digital euro pilot
articles.description: Euro-area online and mobile merchants can apply until Oct. 27 to test beta digital euro payments in a 12-month pilot.

articles.title: AI has been a ‘net negative’ for crypto: Phemex CEO
articles.description: Federico Variola says AI has diverted capital from crypto and is empowering attackers, while rising cybersecurity costs could push the industry toward greater centralization.

articles.title: US charges ex-Robinhood engineers over alleged pre-listing crypto trades
articles.description: The former employees allegedly earned more than $50,000 each by trading Hyperliquid perpetuals ahead of Robinhood token listings.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $450M in biggest outflow since June
articles.description: The $450 million withdrawal came as Bitcoin fell 2.5% and the CLARITY Act failed to advance in the Senate, with Fidelity and BlackRock funds leading the outflows.

articles.title: Crypto industry turns to US regulators after CLARITY setback
articles.description: The CLARITY Act still has a procedural path after Senator Thom Tillis moved to reconsider the failed cloture vote, though industry executives are divided over whether Congress has enough time left.

articles.title: BIS paper finds major gap in Bitcoin onchain transfer estimates
articles.description: A BIS study found widely used crypto metrics can obscure economic activity, with measurement challenges spanning Bitcoin, Ethereum and stablecoins.
